Volume (GAP-1833): this module states no deviation, screening or queue volume, and no source gives one. The platform figures are the only ones available: 23,600 open cases at go-live and 3,110 new a month (NFR-001), about 370 staff online of 914 (NFR-002) and 300 milliseconds per rule evaluation (NFR-011). The two evaluation samples are 200 and 500 cases. The real deviation rate is measured in the shadow run before the wave 2 volume test is sized.

disposition.change: Section 16 now states the platform NFR figures and the two samples, asserts no module volume, and sets the shadow-run measurement before wave 2 sizing.
disposition.note: Volume stated from platform NFRs and the two samples; no module volume asserted; rate to be measured in shadow run.

disposition.change: Map the agent case read to API-P5-002 and the document read to API-P5-003, with API-P5-009 for an extracted-field filter; publish the tool call field names in the rwb-document AsyncAPI and OpenAPI.
disposition.note: Tool contract mapping to P5 operations belongs in the contract and rwb-document specs; no story edit required.

disposition.change: Fix the DocumentStored payload as documentId, caseId, documentType, source and storedAt; state the idempotency key is the outbox event ID; mirror in RWB-P10-E1062-CON.
disposition.note: Payload fields and idempotency key are not fixed in any source; they must be published in the event AsyncAPI and the contract.

disposition.change: Publish the mask format and the per-role list of personal document fields; state SY-AGENT holds Documents R with every personal field masked and no clear value in answer, log or trace. Format and list: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1049).
disposition.note: Mask format and personal field list are absent from all sources; rwb-access must publish them with the masking contract.

disposition.change: State that a stored document is served with the type on its row and is never re-typed on read, and that the 422 MSG-P5-006 unknown-type refusal applies at store time only.
disposition.note: Read rule for a stored document whose type left the version in force belongs to the P5 story; this story only reads.

disposition.change: Set the default scope of SY-AGENT to ALL (LOV-SCOPE) in the matrix version in force; state the scope rule for every non-human actor role in the access and administration documentation.
disposition.note: Scope is matrix data; the non-human actor rule is absent from access documentation and must be stated there.

disposition.change: No edit: section 16 already holds TC-E1-062-11 and TC-E1-062-14 for AC2.
disposition.note: AC2 is covered by TC-E1-062-11 and TC-E1-062-14 in section 16; no edit needed.
